guide.p: Form and note completion usually appears in Part 1 (a conversation about booking, registering or enquiring) and sometimes in Part 4 (notes on a lecture). You hear specific details — names, numbers, days, prices, objects — and write them in the gaps.

bullets: Read the title first: it tells you the situation (a hotel booking, a job enquiry).
For each gap, predict the kind of answer: a number, a price, a day, a noun, a plural noun.
Check the word limit. ONE WORD AND/OR A NUMBER means 'seventeen' or '17' or 'garage' but never 'the garage'.
The questions follow the order of the recording. If you miss one, move on immediately.
Write exactly the words you hear. Do not change the form of the word.
Self-correction: 'Tuesday — no, sorry, Wednesday is better.' The second answer is right.
Two options mentioned, one rejected: 'We have a single or a double… the double is fully booked.'
Changed details: 'It used to cost £40, but now it's £45.'
Information that is already on the form is not tested again — skip it.

guide.example: You read: 'Deposit: £___'. You hear: 'The deposit was thirty pounds last year, but it's gone up to thirty-five.' Answer: 35.

guide.tip: Gaps next to units (£, km, a.m.) need only the number. Do not write the unit again.

script.speaker: woman
script.text: Good afternoon, Harbour Cycle Hire. How can I help?

script.speaker: man
script.text: Hi, I'd like to book a bike for this weekend. I was thinking of a mountain bike, but actually I'll mostly be on the coast road, so a hybrid would be better.

script.speaker: woman
script.text: Fine, a hybrid. And how long do you need it for? We charge by the day.

script.speaker: man
script.text: From Friday to Sunday, so three days. Can I collect it on Friday morning, around nine?

script.speaker: woman
script.text: I'm afraid we don't open until half past nine on Fridays.

script.speaker: man
script.text: Then half past nine is fine. Do I need to bring my own helmet?

script.speaker: woman
script.text: No, a helmet's included free. But if you want a lock, that's two pounds extra per day. And we take a deposit of sixty pounds. It used to be fifty, but it went up this year.

script.speaker: man
script.text: Okay. I'll take the lock as well, then.
